purpose: Say that a category does not limit eligibility or applicability.
keywords: You may apply whether or not you have experience.
Anyone may use it regardless of nationality.
We accept inquiries day and night.
restrictions: Common with age, nationality, experience, time, and gender.
mistake: Use a category capable of variation, rather than an unrelated fact.
